text: put out: Heb. blinded | in chains: Or, fetters | prison: Heb. house of the wards
captain of the guard: Or, chief Marshal. Heb. chief of the executioners or slaughtermen. And so vers. 14. etc. | served: Heb. stood before
shovels: Or, instruments to remove the ashes | bowles: Or, basons
were near the kings person: Heb. saw the face of the king | principal scribe: Or, scribe of the captain of the host
kindly unto him: Heb. good things with him
every day a portion: Heb. the matter of the day in his day
